title: Browser Agent v86 LLM model catalog
description: Schema for data/llm-models.json. The catalog is an array of model entries shown in the LLM panel.

id.description: Stable unique identifier used by selection, policies and local state. Do not rename without migrating references.

label.description: Full model name shown in selectors and panels.

shortLabel.description: Short model name for badges, status text and compact UI.

engine.description: Runtime used to execute the model.

engineLabel.description: Human-readable runtime label shown in the UI.

model.description: Runtime model identifier. For Ollama this is the local tag; for Transformers.js it is usually a compatible Hugging Face repository.

task.description: Model task. Current values are typically chat for Ollama and text-generation for Transformers.js.

device.description: Execution device. Ollama uses remote; Transformers.js uses webgpu or wasm.

dtype.description: Numeric format or quantization requested from the runtime.

sizeLabel.description: Approximate model size displayed in the UI. Informational only.

repoSizeLabel.description: Repository, tag or quantization detail shown in the UI. Informational only.

minMemoryLabel.description: Approximate RAM/VRAM note shown in the UI. Informational only.

languageLabel.description: Short language/capability summary shown in the UI.

requiresShaderF16.description: true when a WebGPU model requires shader-f16 support.

requiresWebGPU.description: false allows remote or WASM models; true means WebGPU is required.

toolProfile.description: Tool capability profile used by chat-state.ts to derive tool limits and defaults.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent to the model. Lower values are more deterministic.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling top_p value sent to the model.

ollamaThink.description: Ollama-only thinking toggle when supported by the model and server.

thinking.description: Reasoning extraction via AI SDK extractReasoningMiddleware (Transformers.js) or UI toggle. tagName must match the XML tags emitted by the model.

enabled.description: Show the thinking toggle and apply reasoning middleware when tag-based extraction applies.

tagName.description: XML tag name for extractReasoningMiddleware, e.g. think or redacted_thinking.

startWithReasoning.description: AI SDK extractReasoningMiddleware option for models that omit the opening tag.

contextWindowTokens.description: Context window budget used by src/chat/runtime/context-budget.ts to derive prompt and output limits.

maxNewTokens.description: Optional explicit output hard cap. If omitted, context-budget.ts derives output from contextWindowTokens - safeInputTokens.

contextPreset.description: Named context budget preset expanded by chat-state.ts before runtime use. contextPolicy may still override individual preset fields.

contextPolicy.description: Optional per-model budget overrides merged after contextPreset by context-budget.ts and chat-state.ts. The whole object is optional; every field inside is also optional because runtime defaults (DEFAULT_LOCAL_POLICY, DEFAULT_OLLAMA_POLICY, defaultContextMeta) fill missing values.

provider.description: Budget profile family. Catalog Transformers.js entries set transformersjs; Ollama models usually omit contextPolicy and receive ollama defaults at runtime.

contextWindowTokens.description: Override for the model context window used when deriving input/output budgets.

safeInputTokens.description: Input token budget reserved for system, runtime, history and tool results before output is computed.

reservedOutputTokens.description: Optional static output reservation. Usually omitted; getPolicy() derives output limits dynamically.

maxSystemChars.description: Character cap for the system prompt block.

maxRuntimeChars.description: Character cap for runtime/context injected into the system prompt.

maxHistoryMessages.description: Maximum prior chat turns kept in the prompt.

maxHistoryChars.description: Character cap across retained history messages.

maxToolResultChars.description: Character cap for tool results included in agent turns.

maxToolResultCharsForSynthesis.description: Character cap for tool results during synthesis/final answer steps.

maxArtifacts.description: Maximum artifacts attached to a prompt. Rarely set in the catalog; defaults come from provider policy.

maxOutputTokens.description: Optional hard cap on generated output tokens for chat/synthesis before kind-specific limits apply.

maxNewTokensForPlan.description: Optional cap for plan-generation steps. If omitted, resolveMaxOutputTokens() uses 768 for Ollama and 384 for local Transformers.js.

maxNewTokensForSynthesis.description: Optional cap for synthesis output. Usually omitted because getPolicy() derives it from resolveMaxOutputTokens().

agent.description: Optional per-model agent/tool overrides. Missing fields are filled from generic defaults in chat-state.ts.

maxSteps.description: Maximum AI SDK agent steps for a tool turn before runtime caps are applied.

maxNativeTools.description: Maximum number of active native tools sent to the model.

toolCalling.description: How many tool steps the runtime should allow for this model.

defaultNativeTools.description: Optional default tool names. Usually omitted so profile priority decides.

selfSelectTools.description: true when tests show the model should be allowed to decide tool use before heuristic fallback.

custom.description: true for entries that let the user type a model name in the UI.

experimental.description: true for test, fallback, slow or less recommended models.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the LLM panel.
